_comment: Harmonia install configuration template. Copy to config.json and fill in the values you need. All fields are optional — omit any you don't want to configure. Use with: curl ... | sh -s -- --config config.json

vault_secrets._comment: API keys and credentials stored in the encrypted vault. Only include the ones you need.
vault_secrets._comment_pgp: Pot-provisioned identity. The provisioner generates these per-agent and renders them into the bootstrap config; the agent's `setup --headless-config` step seeds them into vault.
vault_secrets._comment_tailnet: Short-lived tailscale auth-key minted by the marketplace at provision time so the agent's tsnet stack can join the operator's tailnet on first boot. Used once and traded for a long-lived node key.

config_store._comment: Config-store key/value pairs organized by component > scope > key. Only include what you need.

trust_bundle._comment: Bootstrap list of operator devices the agent should trust on first boot. The provisioner pulls these from the marketplace at agent-create time. Each entry's `device_public_key` is added to the agent's PGP trust-store.
trust_bundle._comment_format: [{"device_id": "...", "client_fp": "...", "device_public_key": "-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----\n...\n-----END PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----"}]
